automatedChecks.note: Passing structural checks do not prove semantic correctness.

independentCriticalReview.note: All critical runtime defects were independently confirmed. Exact restoration of affected official items still requires comparison against the corresponding official source PDFs.

criticalImplementation.note: The paid-detail gate is a data contract for the isolated payment implementation. Existing free routes and UI were intentionally not changed in this branch.

findings.currentKey: A: The possibility to discover your feelings
findings.proposedKeyOrWording: Change key to B, or rewrite A as 'express their feelings' and revalidate uniqueness.
findings.evidence: The passage says express feelings, not discover feelings. B is supported by accepting one another and differences.

findings.proposedKeyOrWording: Rewrite the Taj Mahal passage from authoritative facts, then revalidate all eight keys.
findings.evidence: The passage misnames Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal, uses incorrect construction dates, and calls the reflecting pool a lake. UNESCO states construction began in 1632, the principal mausoleum was completed in 1648, and other buildings/garden followed later.

findings.proposedKeyOrWording: Do not infer new keys. Restore the exact official notices or temporarily withdraw these items.

findings.currentKey: B: It was named a City of Books.
findings.proposedKeyOrWording: B: It was named UNESCO World Book Capital for 2007.

findings.currentKey: C: They reduced crime and increased community engagement.
findings.proposedKeyOrWording: Remove the unsupported crime-reduction claim or add a concrete primary source and rewrite the answer to match it.

findings.currentKey: B: Future space missions are planned to collect samples from other planets.
findings.proposedKeyOrWording: B: More research, including sample-return missions, will be needed.
findings.evidence: The passage says missions will be required; it does not establish that they are already planned.

findings.currentKey: B: The item is second-hand and sold to support a good cause
findings.proposedKeyOrWording: B: The item was donated and its sale supports charity.
findings.evidence: Donated does not necessarily mean second-hand.

findings.proposedKeyOrWording: See high-severity numbering finding and add a monotonic-order regression test.

paywallArchitecture.reason: The browser currently receives answer keys and rationales and calculates results client-side; a visual lock would be bypassable.
freeExperience: No forced lead before showing the earned summary
paidExperience: Correct answer, evidence, rationale and distractor analysis
Access via either active subscription entitlement or one-time attempt entitlement
requiredBoundary: Ship a public question DTO with no answer, rationale or evidence.
Grade server-side from a private canonical bank and ignore client-supplied scores.
Persist attempts privately and return only the free summary.
Protect detail APIs server-side with a unified entitlement check.
Reuse the proven Wompi webhook and HttpOnly capability pattern from the TOEFL report pipeline.
Remove private review and guided-detail routes from sitemap and cache them private/no-store.
acceptanceTests: No answer key or rationale appears in HTML, RSC payloads or browser bundles before entitlement.
Unauthenticated or unpaid detail requests return 403.
Client manipulation of answer, score, price, currency, environment or reference cannot unlock detail.
Only a verified APPROVED Wompi event grants one-time access; pending or declined never do.
An active subscription and a one-time purchase use the same server-side entitlement interface.
The end-to-end flow returns to the exact attempt after login or payment.

minimumToProceed: Resolve or withdraw every blockProduction finding.
Run a second independent reviewer on every changed item.
Add official per-item source manifests and legal review.
Implement server-side grading and entitlement enforcement in the isolated paywall worktree.
Pass content, authorization, payment, leakage and end-to-end regression tests.
